full_judgment: 3. The case of the plaintiffs, in short, is that A. Gofur was tenant under Ray Bihari Lal Bahadur represented by Administrator General of Bengal. Due to arrear of rent landlord filed Rent Suit 1941 of 1940 and got decree and the suit land was sold in Rent Execution Case 622 of 1943 and auction was purchased by Hachen Uddin on 9-11- 1943 and got possession on 14-3-1944. It is further stated that another Rent Suit 1927 of 1948 was subsequently filed and the suit land was again sold in Rent Execution Case 404 of 1949 and auction was purchased by Gogon Ali and Mofizuddin Howlader on 31-5-1949 which was confirmed on 14-4-1949 and later on possession was delivered. Auction purchasers settled the suit land with the predecessors of the plaintiffs named Rahman Faraji, Kader Faraji, Abdul Hakim, Gani Faraji, Abdul Motaleb, Abdul Khaleque, Muslemuddin and Tofayel Ahmed at an annual rental of 50 taka 6 anna and accordingly RS record 487 was prepared in their names. Gani, Motaleb, Khaleque possessed 8 annas share wherefrom they sold 0.304 acres to plaintiff 1 and Erfan by kabala dated 24-3-1955. Erfan sold 0.16 acres to plaintiff 4 and 0.16 acres to plaintiff 2 and 3 by two kabalas dated 21-4-1983. Rahman executed a patta in respect of 0.32 acres of land on 5-6-1950 to Mofizuddin who sold the same to Erfan, Hachen, Azhar by kabala dated 3-4-1956. Erfan transferred his share to plaintiffs 2 and 3. Azhar made an oral gift of his share to grandson plaintiff 2. It is also stated that one Tofazzal sold by kabala dated 12-4-1949 to Ibrahim who sold 0.63 acres to Erfan and plaintiff 1 through kabala dated 14-11-1955. Erfan orally gifted his share to plaintiff 2. Tofayel transferred 0.81 acres of land in favour of Sultan, Lehaj Uddin, Anwara through kabala 2976 dated 23-10-1956. Sultan died leaving behind plaintiffs 10, 11 and 12. Lehaj Uddin was the predecessor of plaintiffs 13-18. Anwara died and her heirs sold the land to plaintiff 2. Tofayel also sold 0.32 acres to plaintiff 1 through kabala dated 7-3-1955. Plaintiff 1 sold 0.08 acres to plaintiff 20 on 12-6-2007. Thus plaintiffs acquired 5.44 acres of land as mentioned in schedule `Kha'. The RS and SA record were correctly prepared jointly with the predecessor of the defendants. Due to inconvenience in possession plaintiff asked defendants for partition but they did not pay any heed to it and refused the same on 2nd Boishakh, 1411 BS. Hence the suit was filed.
